notes: Source: official Midas "DL32 Product Information Document" (2016, MUSIC Group IP Ltd) — the copy on midasconsoles.com 404'd during research, so this is a third-party-hosted mirror (sgssistemas.lv) of the same manufacturer PDF, cross-checked against the rear-panel photo included in that PDF and against the manualslib-hosted DL32 user manual specs page. 32 mic inputs are plain XLR3 female (Neutrik) with switchable 48V phantom, no combo/TRS option. 16 line outputs are balanced XLR3 male. Two AES50 ports (Neutrik etherCON) carry 48 bidirectional channels @48kHz for cascading to an M32-series console or a second DL-series stagebox; their eth-100m grade is inferred from AES50/SuperMAC's well-documented 100BASE-TX (100Mbps Fast Ethernet) physical layer — the DL32 datasheet itself does not state a Mbps figure, hence overall confidence is medium rather than high. ULTRANET (also Neutrik etherCON) is listed as output-only on this box (feeds Behringer P16 personal monitors / Turbosound iQ speakers with 16 channels of audio+control); it rides Cat5 wiring but is not standard-timed Ethernet, so no eth-* grade was assigned. Two ADAT optical outputs are labeled on the rear panel with a channel range (rendered ambiguously through OCR as "17-24"/"25-32"); exact channel mapping could not be fully confirmed from the source image, so port names were kept generic ("ADAT OUT 1"/"ADAT OUT 2"). Two AES3(AES/EBU) outputs are on XLR3 connectors labeled "OUT 13-14" and "OUT 15-16" (digital duplicates of analog outs 13-16). Chassis is confirmed 3U (483 x 242 x 138mm) via the bullet "Rugged 3U rackmount chassis" and the measured height, despite one inconsistent marketing line elsewhere in the same PDF claiming "only takes up two rack spaces."

ports.name: AES50 A
ports.note: Klark Teknik SuperMAC/AES50 port, 48 bidirectional channels @48kHz; grade inferred from AES50's documented 100BASE-TX Fast Ethernet PHY, not stated explicitly on this datasheet

ports.name: AES50 B
ports.note: Klark Teknik SuperMAC/AES50 port for cascading a second DL-series stagebox; grade inferred, see AES50 A note

ports.name: ULTRANET
ports.note: Neutrik etherCON connector; ULTRANET is a proprietary Cat5 protocol (not standard Ethernet PHY timing), so no eth-* grade assigned

ports.name: USB
ports.note: Type B port for firmware/system updates via PC; USB speed not stated

ports.name: AC/POWER
